description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to a video decoder pipeline for ChromeOS, including the VideoDecoderMixin interface and the VideoDecoderPipeline class, which manages video decoding, format negotiation, and resource management for ChromeOS devices.

classes.name: VideoDecoderMixin
classes.description: Interface extending VideoDecoder with additional methods for ChromeOS video decoding pipeline management.

classes.name: VideoDecoderPipeline
classes.description: Implements a video decoder pipeline for ChromeOS, managing decoding, format negotiation, resource pools, and communication with the client.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a VideoDecoderPipeline instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: CreateForTesting
methods.description: Factory method for creating a test instance of VideoDecoderPipeline.

methods.name: NotifySupportKnown
methods.description: Ensures supported video configurations are known and invokes callback with the supported decoder remote.

methods.name: GetSupportedConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves supported video decoder configurations based on decoder type and workarounds.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with configuration, CDM, and callbacks.

methods.name: GetVideoFramePool
methods.description: Returns the video frame pool used by the pipeline.

methods.name: PrepareChangeResolution
methods.description: Prepares the pipeline for a resolution change.

methods.name: PickDecoderOutputFormat
methods.description: Negotiates and selects the decoder output format.
